fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Whatever has happened, don’t wait it out. The earlier we see a dental problem, the simpler the treatment usually is. Here’s what to do before you get to us.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Check your teeth after any knock to the face. If an adult tooth has been knocked out, don’t scrub it. Holding it by the crown, try to sit it gently back in the socket and keep it there. If you can’t, put it in a small container of milk and come straight in - minutes matter.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Find the fragment if you can and keep it damp - it can sometimes be bonded back on. Rinse your mouth with warm water and call us. Even a small chip is worth checking, because a weakened tooth can crack further.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Keep the crown and bring it with you. The exposed tooth will often feel sensitive to hot, cold and air, and it is weaker than it feels - chew on the other side until we’ve seen it.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ongoing, intense tooth or jaw pain is an emergency, not something to push through. It can signal an infection that will spread if left. Call us the same day - we keep time for emergencies.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Gums that bleed when you brush usually point to gum disease - book a visit, but it isn’t urgent. Bleeding that won’t stop after an extraction is different: bite firmly on clean gauze or a clean cloth and call us straight away.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Don’t try to glue a denture back together - household adhesives damage the material and can make a proper repair impossible. Collect the pieces and bring them in.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Never cut a broken wire. If it’s poking, try to reposition it gently with the eraser end of a pencil, or cover the end with orthodontic wax, and call us for an appointment.

fields.label: Sub heading
fields.value: Not sure how urgent it is?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Call us and describe what’s happening. We’ll tell you honestly whether it needs to be seen today, tomorrow or at your next check-up - and what to do in the meantime.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some situations need a hospital, not a dentist. Call 000 or go to the nearest emergency department if you have:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: facial swelling that affects breathing or swallowing

fields.label: List item
fields.value: swelling spreading towards the eye or down the neck
